theme.overridesDesc: Theme token overrides (via radial inspector) will appear here. Full overrides UI lands in the Theme Menu pass.
theme.accessibilityDesc: WCAG contrast readout for the active theme lands in the Theme Menu pass.

typography.comingDesc: Per-token font role assignment, custom font import, and per-weight overrides are planned for v89+.

inspector.previewDesc: Live radial inspector preview renders here. Full inspector internals land in v89.
inspector.activationDesc: Hotkey rebind for radial inspector activation lands in v89 alongside the hotkey registry.
inspector.behaviorDesc: Dim graph while inspecting, persist recent swatches, and draggable inspector panel toggles land in v89.
inspector.comingDesc: Per-spoke configuration, default scope picker, custom spoke order — v89.

dataSources.activeDesc: Source adapter status and loaded graph info lands in v95. For now, the active graph is the self-graph fixture loaded by the Vite plugin on startup.
dataSources.adaptersDesc: Adapter activation toggles and connection configuration land in v95.
dataSources.comingDesc: Adapter activation (v95) · Diff triage (v95) · Profile/vault switcher (v97).

display.mirrorsDesc: Display mirrors (Effects, Reduce Motion, Panel Blur, Glow Intensity, Motion Scale) are accessible in Theme. Full mirror surface lands in the Display pass alongside performance mode (v90).
display.comingDesc: Performance mode (v90) · Particle density (v92) · Detail level slider (v90) · 3D minimap controls (v94).

accessibility.wcagDesc: Contrast target level and contrast warning toggles land in v93 alongside OKLCH color migration and APCA contrast targets.
accessibility.colorblindDesc: Deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia simulation modes land in v93.
accessibility.comingDesc: APCA contrast targets (v93) · Motion intensity floor (v93).

advanced.devtoolsDesc: Window probe exposure toggle and provenance manifest regeneration land in v95 alongside the Advanced category full implementation.
advanced.flagsDesc: Feature flag browser lands in v95. Flags are currently managed in the settings store directly.
advanced.resetDesc: Clear-all-overrides and reset-all-settings destructive actions land in v95.

inspector.comingDesc: Per-spoke configuration, default scope picker, custom spoke order — v89.

commandDeck.title: Command Deck
commandDeck.contractDesc: Command execution is locked/deferred to v37 or later.
commandDeck.descriptionText: The Command Deck is a discovery surface for available actions. In v36, it displays only passive metadata. No commands can be executed from this interface.
commandDeck.hotkeyFootnote: No new hotkeys may be added without registry approval.
commandDeck.commandFootnote: Command registry is read-only. No commands can be executed.
commandDeck.perspectiveLocked: Locked in v38 - requires explicit contract
commandDeck.perspectiveFootnote: Perspective registry is read-only. No perspective switching.
